ablage.aufraeumen_frage: Go through everything in the inbox once and file it?\n\nIt only moves mail where you have filed it yourself. Nothing is reported. Every move is listed in the journal afterwards and can be undone one by one.
ablage.aufraeumen_hilfe: In normal operation it only looks at new mail. Whatever already sits in the inbox it has never touched — “Tidy” does that once. It reports nothing while doing so; every move is listed in the journal below and can be undone.
ablage.schwaechen: Where your filing wobbles ({a} ambiguous, {b} nearly empty, {c} empty)
ablage.schwaechen_hilfe: That is not a fault, it is the raw material for later: senders you have filed sometimes here, sometimes there — for those the mail stays put, to be safe.
ablage.titel: Your filing — this is what it learns from
ablage.wie: It puts new mail exactly where you have already put mail from that sender — and nowhere else. It invents no destination and creates no folder. Learned: {zeit}.
allg.hinterlegt: stored — leave empty to keep it
dok.gehen_los: {n} mail(s) are going to DocuSort — this takes a moment.
dok.nachtrag_laeuft: Going through the folders — this only reads, it changes nothing.
dok.nichts: Nothing found. If the backlog is still open, perhaps only the catch-up is missing.
dok.noch_nichts: Nothing looked at yet — the watchman catches up on its next run, or you press “Catch up on the backlog now”.
dok.ordner_offen: {offen} of {gesamt} folders not gone through yet
dok.rueckfrage:
Hand {n} mails to DocuSort?

DocuSort reads every document one by one (text recognition and filing) — that costs time and money over there.
At most 60 documents go per round; the rest stays selected.
dok.suchfeld: Search — sender, subject, file name, folder
dok.unterwegs: {n} on the way — DocuSort is filing them
dok.zwilling: the same file is already in DocuSort
dok.zwilling_titel: same file name and same size, handed over on {datum}
ds.hilfe: When post arrives with a PDF (or a bank CSV), the Postwache passes the attachment to DocuSort — through the same front door a browser uses. Photos, calendar invitations and signature images stay out. If something looks like phishing, nothing is passed on.
ds.stand.kann_docusort_nicht: DocuSort does not take this file type
ds.stand.pruefen: in DocuSort — waiting for your review
ds.stand.uebergeben: in DocuSort — being filed right now
ds.stand.verschollen: DocuSort no longer knows it — hand it over again
fuss.spruch: sorts the noise out, not what matters
heimat.hilfe: These write to you again and again — and for them there is no folder. That, not some over-cautious threshold, is where sorting fails: it can only imitate, and where you have never filed anything there is nothing to imitate. One click and it sits for good.
heimat.leer: Every recurring sender has a home.
journal.alle_frage: Bring all {n} mails back to the inbox?
journal.leer_lernlauf: In learning mode nothing is moved either.
ki.hilfe:
When mail fits into no drawer, a language model can propose rules. It sorts nothing — you are the one who accepts.
🔴 Only the sender, name, subject and the reason leave this machine. Never the text of a mail, never an attachment.
ki.hilfe.anthropic: Sender and subject go to Anthropic. Costs per request.
ki.hilfe.aus: The watchman decides on its own. Unclear mail waits on this page.
ki.hilfe.ollama: Runs on your own hardware. Nothing leaves the house.
ki.hilfe.openai: Sender and subject go to OpenAI. Costs per request.
ki.hilfe.werkstatt: Puts the cases in a folder your own agent picks them up from.
leer.text: The Postwache looks at nothing as long as no mailbox is set up. It takes a minute.
mail.phishing: stays in the inbox, click nothing.
mail.wahl_titel: Always put post from this sender here
mails.hilfe: If a classification is wrong, change it on the right. It remembers that for this sender and applies it from then on.
mails.titel: What it filed last — and why
pf.entfernen_frage: Take “{name}” off the list?\n\nWhat it learned stays — add the mailbox again and it is right back.
pf.hilfe: Every mailbox keeps its own learned state — its own filing, its own sender profiles, its own attachment index. They never get in each other's way.
pf.kennung_bleibt: The id {id} stays — what it learned hangs on it.
pf.name: Display name
pf.prueft: The connection is tested as soon as you save.
regel.sofort: tells you at once via Telegram
regeln.hilfe: That is decided by the content — no matter which folder the mail goes to.
sprache.fehler: The language could not be changed.
sprache.hilfe: Applies to the whole Postwache — including the messages it sends when nobody is looking.
stat.quelle: From {mails} mails in {ordner} folders ({von} to {bis}). The daily curve starts on {ab}, because before that not every folder had been read completely. Your own post is not counted ({eigene}). As of {stand}.
steuer.notaus_hilfe: Works even when Home Assistant does not answer.
steuer.scharf_an: It moves noise out of the inbox. Every move can be undone below.
steuer.scharf_aus: Learning mode: it only classifies and shows what it would do. Nothing is touched.
steuer.steht: The watchman is stopped and does not look into the mailbox at all.
steuer.telegram: Immediate notice for what matters, and the daily summary at {stunde}.
steuer.wichtig: Leave what matters where it is
steuer.wichtig_an: Deadlines, official post, security and people stay in the inbox, even when it knows where they belong.
steuer.wichtig_aus: What matters is filed too — you are still told at once.
tg.keiner: no bot entered — then it only reports on this page
tg.start_hinweis: Open your bot in Telegram and press Start once, before you save here. A bot may not write to you before that — Telegram then answers “chat not found”, which looks like a wrong chat ID but is not one.
umg.ha_an: ✓ connected — the switch on your phone stops the Postwache.
umg.ha_aus: Without Home Assistant. The emergency stop then goes through the file DISABLED.
umg.seite_hilfe: The page address appears in every Telegram message. If it is wrong, the links lead nowhere.
umgebung.hilfe: Where this Postwache stands. Leaving a field empty means “find out yourself” — what you enter wins.
vorschlag.hilfe: Proposed by the judgment helper. None of them applies until you accept it.
w.bericht.bilanz: Sorted out: {laerm}, left in the inbox: {wichtig}.
w.bericht.leer: No new post in the last 24 hours.
w.bericht.lernlauf: _Learning mode_ — nothing was moved. WOULD have sorted out: {laerm}.
w.dok.detail: {n} document(s) from new post handed over.
w.kalt.detail: {n} mails classified as a starting point ({verteilung}) — nothing reported, nothing moved.
w.migration.detail: The existing mailbox is now called “standard”; {n} state file(s) were filed under it. Nothing changes about what the watchman does.
w.pause.detail: The pause has ended, the watchman is running again.
w.sortiert.detail: {n} mail(s) moved from the inbox into subfolders.
w.unklar.detail: The agent could not be reached. They are listed with their reason on the page — there you can assign them to a sender for good: {seite}
w.vorschlag.detail: From {n} unclear mails. Look at them on the page and accept them one by one — none applies by itself.
w.weckruf.detail: Task #{nr} — {n} unclear mails. It proposes rules, you decide.
